751-955-6006.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shrieking Drake by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

339-647-677-7272.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
339-647-677-7272.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing Jegantha, giving Reaper of Flight Moonsilver +2/+1 until end of turn
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2645-3430-4348-5621.easyPrerequisites: Ley Druid doesn't have summoning sickness.
2645-3430-4348-5621.description:
Activate Arid Archway by tapping it, adding six {C} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Activate Ley Druid by tapping it, untapping Arid Archway
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Ley Druid.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1339-2811-8192.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1339-2811-8192.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters, Elas il-Kor triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, causing you to pay 1 life to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

277-2187-5531-5694-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
277-2187-5531-5694-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Possessed Skaab and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Possessed Skaab and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield
When the lands enter, Tiller Engine triggers that many times, untapping the lands.
Resolve the Possessed Skaab trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield
When the land(s) enter, Tiller Engine triggers that many times, untapping the land(s)
Repeat.
277-2187-5531-5694-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Possessed Skaab and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-745-1619-3680.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-745-1619-3680.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Mirrorhall Mimic and Stunt Double each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Mirrorhall Mimic trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Stunt Double trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-745-1619-3680.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

1409-3099-4927-6723.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

204-1858-2056-2633-5434.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one white permanent.
204-1858-2056-2633-5434.description:
Cast View from Above by paying {1}{U}.
Urabrask and Saheeli trigger.
Resolve the Urabrask trigger, adding {R} and dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Resolve the Saheeli trigger, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve View from Above, returning it to your hand.
Activate the Servo by tapping it, adding {U} that can only be spent to cast an instant or sorcery spell, or to gain a Class level.
Repeat.

856-2438-5776-7422.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Garrison Excavator trigger.
Resolve the Garrison Excavator trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

4659-7282-7333.description:
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating a token copy of Mouser Foundry.
When Mouser Foundry enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Robot artifact creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the Robot and the Mouser Foundry token, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Mouser Foundry triggers, creating a 1/1 Robot artifact creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Robot, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-3334-3899-4552-4832.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it due to Blossoming Tortoise, creating a 2/2 Spawn artifact creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing the Spawn, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat

147-413-6818.description:
Cast Return to Action by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Return to Action, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Return to Action.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, Return to Action triggers, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Blasting Station abilities from step 5.

1170-1329-4708-6791.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Dark Sphere from your graveyard.
Cast Dark Sphere by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Dark Sphere by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

1003-2292-5220-6900.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker
When Phyrexian Walker dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Cast Phyrexian Walker from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Enigma Jewel // Locus of Enlightenment

74-270-617.description:
Activate Hedron Archive by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Key by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting Hedron Archive.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying Voltaic Key's ability, targeting Voltaic Key.
Resolve both Voltaic Key abilities, untapping it and Hedron Archive.
Repeat.

2457-3000-4289-6633.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

requires.n: Cards Allowing a Creature to Tap for Free

1636-5641-6702--119.description:
Tap Kilo by any method.
Kilo triggers, causing you to proliferate and put a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
1636-5641-6702--119.notes: This combo also gives you infinite products from whatever method you use to tap Kilo. You can also sacrifice the Eldrazi Spawns for mana and other results.

654-2608-2882-4050-6644.manaNeeded: {G}{W}{U} plus an additional {1} if you've cast Derevi from the command zone this game
654-2608-2882-4050-6644.description:
If you haven't cast Derevi from the command zone this game, cast it by paying {G}{W}{U}. Otherwise, activate Derevi by paying {1}{G}{W}{U}, putting it from the command zone onto the battlefield.
Derevi enters the battlefield as a copy of Ancient Adamantoise due to Infinite Reflection.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Derevi, adding {1}.
Choose to return Derevi from your graveyard to the command zone.
When Derevi dies, it triggers, creating ten tapped Treasure tokens.
When the Treasures enter the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers that many times, untapping the Treasures.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {G}{W}{U}.
Repeat.

1737-2829-4853-5004.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {3} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Cathodion.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Cathodion.
When Cathodion dies, Cathodion and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the Cathodion trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Prototype Portal.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2532-3562-4617-4906.notablePrerequisites:
Jaxis does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least one card in hand.
2532-3562-4617-4906.description:
Activate Soulbright Flamekin by paying {2}, targeting Agrus Kos.
Agrus Kos triggers, causing you to pay {1}{R/W} to copy Soulbright Flamekin's ability, targeting every other creature you control.
Resolve all Soulbright Flamekin abilities, adding eight {R} and giving creatures you control trample until end of turn.
Activate Jaxis by paying {R}, tapping it and discarding a card, targeting Agrus Kos.
Agrus Kos triggers, causing you to pay {1}{R/W} to copy Jaxis' ability, targeting every other creature you control.
Resolve all Jaxis abilities, creating a token that's a copy of each other creature you control with haste.
Put the token Agrus Kos into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Agrus Kos and Sky Hussar tokens trigger.
Resolve the Agrus Kos trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Sky Hussar trigger, untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat, using the Soulbright Flamekin token instead.

654-1018-1541-5220-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Skullwinder, adding {R}.
When Skullwinder dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Skullwinder on top of your library from your graveyard.
Cast Hit the Mother Lode by paying {4}{R}{R}{R}, exiling Skullwinder from the top of your library and casting it without paying its mana cost, and creating seven tapped Treasure artifact tokens.
When Skullwinder and the Treasures enter the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers seven times and Skullwinder triggers once.
Resolve all Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping the Treasures.
Resolve the Skullwinder trigger, returning Hit the Mother Lode from your graveyard to your hand, and causing an opponent to return a card from their graveyard to their hand.
Activate six Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

659-3750-5231.easyPrerequisites: Krenko, Mob Boss does not have summoning sickness.
659-3750-5231.notablePrerequisites: You control at least X Goblins.
659-3750-5231.description:
Activate Krenko by tapping it, creating at least X 1/1 Goblin creature tokens.
Activate Thermopod twice by sacrificing two Goblin tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}, untapping Krenko.
Repeat.

1651-2585-2645-3094-4176.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three additional artifacts.
1651-2585-2645-3094-4176.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Karn triggers.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Karn's ability.
Resolve the copy of Karn's ability, adding {C} for each artifact you control that cannot be spent to cast nonartifact spells.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Staff of Domination and Grim Monolith, untapping Lithoform Engine.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Activate Grim Monolith's second ability by paying {4}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

471-852-2615.notablePrerequisites:
Vhati il-Dal and Tree of Perdition do not have summoning sickness.
Your life total is at lest two.
471-852-2615.description:
Activate Vhati il-Dal by tapping it, causing Tree of Perdition to have base toughness 1 until end of turn.
Activate Tree of Perdition by tapping it, swapping an opponent's life total with Tree of Perdition's toughness.
Activate Pestilence Demon by paying {B}, dealing 1 damage to each creature and each player.
The opponent targeted in step 2 loses the game due to having zero life.
You may repeat this during each of your turns if your life total allows.

1479-2232-2896.notablePrerequisites: You have a nonartifact enchantment creature in your graveyard with a mana value of two or greater.
1479-2232-2896.description:
Cast Necromancy by paying {2}{B}.
Necromancy enters the battlefield, triggering itself, Kodama, and Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve the Necromancy trigger, returning a nonartifact enchantment creature with mana value two or greater from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Necromancy to it.
The enchantment creature enters the battlefield, triggering Kodama and Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger from the enchantment creature, returning Necromancy from the battlefield to your hand.
Necromancy leaves the battlefield, causing you to sacrifice the creature it was attached to.
Resolve the Kodama trigger from the enchantment creature, putting Necromancy from your hand onto the battlefield.
Necromancy enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Cloudstone Curio.
Repeat from step 3.

1479-2374-3147.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-2374-3147.description:
Play Azorius Chancery.
When Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, it, Maja, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Maja trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Azorius Chancery from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, it and Maja trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

930-1374-4659.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Universal Automaton, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Universal Automaton from your graveyard by paying {1}.
Repeat.

280-1479-2783.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
280-1479-2783.description:
Play Golgari Rot Farm.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters the battlefield, it, Nesting Dragon, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Nesting Dragon trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Golgari Rot Farm from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters the battlefield, it and Nesting Dragon trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

2265-2445-4929-5189.notablePrerequisites: Cryptic Trilobite has at least three +1/+1 counters.
2265-2445-4929-5189.description:
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from Cryptic Trilobite, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Ghave's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing the Saproling token, putting four +1/+1 counters on Cryptic Trilobite.
Repeat.
